channel.title: [Notice] Stakehouse: Full DAO-based Operations
channel.description:
## Overview
Stakehouse protocol (powering LSD Networks, Fren delegation, KETH etc) platform management will be coming under the full control of the DAO managed autonomous operations and continuous upgrades with the support of protocol guardians.
The Stakehouse Dapp on IPFS can be found here: https://dapp-ipfs.joinstakehouse.com/
Stakehous Dapp code is available here: https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/stakehouse-dapp
Stakehouse Formal verification dashboard can be accessed here: https://site--ipfs-joinstakehouse-com.ipns.dweb.link/verification/
Stakehouse audit and formal verification reports:
* https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/Audits/blob/main/Stakehouse%20_Withdrawal_Audit_Report.pdf * https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/Audits/blob/main/Certora_Stakehouse_Report.pdf * https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/Audits/blob/main/Runtime_Verification_Stakehouse_Smart_Contracts_Audit_Report.pdf * https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/Audits/blob/main/Runtime_Verification_Stakehouse_Smart_Contracts_2nd_Audit_Report.pdf * https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/Audits/blob/main/Solidified_Stakehouse_Smart_Contracts_Audit_Report.pdf * https://github.com/stakehouse-dev/Audits/blob/main/Halborn_Stakehouse_Smart_Contract_Security_Audit_Report.pdf
The docs can be found here: https://docs.joinstakehouse.com/protocol/learn/Stakehouse/
With this transition, the following change has been activated:
1. Grant DAO Exclusive ability to upgrade Stakehouse Protocol

Overview

Stakehouse protocol (powering LSD Networks, Fren delegation, KETH etc) platform management will be coming under the full control of the DAO managed autonomous operations and continuous upgrades with the support of protocol guardians.

The Stakehouse Dapp on IPFS can be found here: https://dapp-ipfs.joinstakehouse.com/

Stakehous Dapp code is available here: GitHub - stakehouse-dev/stakehouse-dapp

Stakehouse Formal verification dashboard can be accessed here: https://site--ipfs-joinstakehouse-com.ipns.dweb.link/verification/
